2026_02_NYG_LA.headline: New York brings Week 1 efficiency west as the Rams reset after Australia
2026_02_NYG_LA.paragraph1: The Giants head to SoFi Stadium after an encouraging opening win, with Jaxson Dart coming off an efficient passing performance and adding value as a runner. Los Angeles returns home after beginning its season in Australia and now faces a mobile quarterback plus a New York team playing with early confidence under John Harbaugh. The Rams need to contain Dart without opening scramble lanes; the Giants must protect well enough to keep their passing game on schedule.
2026_02_NYG_LA.model_rationale: Dart’s mobility against Los Angeles’ rush discipline, and New York’s protection against a Rams front playing at home, will determine whether either offense controls down-and-distance.
